answer: Farming becomes a vault bet on surviving 91 epochs of grading, and every sable settlement recomputes the mesa schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 91 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
